caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure with tan skin, dressed in a red garment that drapes over one shoulder and extends down to mid-thigh, revealing the lower part of the legs and bare feet. The figure's left arm hangs at the side, while the right arm is bent with the hand resting on the chest. The figure wears a headdress consisting of three large green feathers attached to a tan headband. There are additional garments beneath the red garment, including a light blue skirt or apron-like piece with faint vertical lines, along with a yellow section visible underneath. The statue stands atop a gray, rectangular, wooden-looking pedestal with visible horizontal lines representing the wood grain and small round details suggesting nails. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the overall composition is centered vertically and horizontally on the page.
title: Cigar Store Indian
